aldershot.snapshot: Aldershot sits in the Blackwater Valley, a busy mix of garrison town, residential streets and trade. Fibre and cabling work here runs from the big build crews down to the one-van installer. Fleets and build contractors order on trade accounts, while sole traders and ex-network engineers order direct online with no account at all. We kit both sides the same, with branded polo, hi-vis and softshell.
aldershot.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Hampshire
s1loc: Aldershot is part of a busy Blackwater Valley full-fibre build. Openreach has pushed its network across the town and out toward Farnborough, Fleet and Frimley, while the alt-net Toob has invested heavily to bring fibre to the premises through the Aldershot, Blackwater and Yateley patch. CityFibre secured Project Gigabit funding for Hampshire alongside this work, so engineers and build crews are working through the town centre, Cargate, North Town and the regenerating Wellesley urban extension on the former garrison land, pulling fibre through streets, cabinets and customer premises across the borough.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a solid commercial scene. The Blackwater Valley industrial estates and units around Aldershot, plus the small business park within the Wellesley development, keep structured-cabling and CCTV installers busy wiring offices, warehouses and trade counters in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre. Local cabling firms work across defence, commercial and education sites, fitting access control, IP CCTV and Power over Ethernet links for cameras and Wi-Fi points. It is steady network and security work across Aldershot and the wider Rushmoor and Surrey borders.
